desc_short: Madison Square Garden: round arena drum with vertical warm bronze precast fins and a light shallow roof with a white rim, a tall dark glass office tower rising behind it, a low podium block in front
Q2 Stadium: soccer stadium, rectangular grass pitch, steep green-seated stands close to the touchlines, white steel truss canopy roof over all stands, green slatted facade panels

L&N Federal Credit Union Stadium: closed football bowl with red seats, tall brick-and-glass press box tower on one sideline, upper deck with white canopy opposite, video board at the closed end, green field
Rupp Arena: large rectangular arena box, flat light roof, beige ribbed metal panel walls, dark glass band at street level, diagonal-braced corner stair towers
